acceptance: A PR whose head predates the probe's posting contract still gets a correct 'release-v2 probe' status (or a clear failure naming the fix), shown by a workflow test or a live PR from an old base.
A PR cannot change the code that posts its own required status (the launcher runs from base), or the decision recorded explains why not.
docs describing release-v2-probe.yml state which revision's scripts run.
context: 2026-11-20 evidence: #4382 (branch from before #4390) failed run 44648125958 twice with the same 403 (`gh api --method POST failed: Resource not accessible by integration`), attempt 2 included, after `make pr-arm` closed and reopened the PR to start CI on a fresh merge ref. github-actions then disabled auto-merge (00:50:39Z). The checkout step takes `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`, so the merge ref's workflow (statuses: write) ran the head's older check-run script. Workaround used: merge origin/develop into the branch. At least nine failing runs from 2026-11-19T20:48Z to 2026-11-20T00:43Z were the same 403.
description:
#4390 (merge 9da6e1c4, 2026-11-19T20:48Z) switched the required 'release-v2 probe' from a check run to a commit status and changed the dispatch job's permissions from checks: write to statuses: write. For pull_request events the workflow definition (and so the token permissions) comes from the merge ref, which includes #4390, but release-v2-probe.yml checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha and runs that tree's scripts/release_probe_launch.py. A branch based before 9da6e1c4 still POSTs repos/.../check-runs, which its statuses-only token refuses with 403 'Resource not accessible by integration', so the required status is never posted and an armed PR cannot merge. Observed on #4393 (feat/polars-matrix-2-1, attempts 1-3), fix/ci-congestion-diagnostics-and-generator-gate, feat/heavy-guard-attribution-engine-caps and feat/corpus-doris-lakesail-tpcds-obt; all four lack 9da6e1c4, and every branch that contains it passed in the same window. Immediate remedy for an affected PR: merge or rebase origin/develop and push. Not a token-settings or repository-rename problem.

Decision gate: run the launch and verdict scripts from the base revision (a second checkout of github.event.pull_request.base.sha, or the merge ref) while the job graph check keeps reading the head's release-v2.yml; or keep head scripts and fail with a clear 'rebase onto develop' message when the head's launcher predates the workflow contract. Prefer the base checkout: it also stops a PR from changing the code that posts its own required status.

Guardrails: the required context stays a commit status; do not grant checks: write back as a workaround; fork refusal unchanged; the graph check must still validate the head's release-v2.yml.
